What the numbers say

For the session of Thursday, October 29, 2026, the DappGo regime model reads the tracked universe (26 US-listed stocks and ETFs on DappGo's reviewed watchlist) as mixed. SPY is above its 50-day average and above its 200-day average; its 20-day trend is sideways and realised volatility is in the calm band.

10 of 26 tickers (38%) are priced above their own 20-day moving average, and 18 of 25 (72%) above their 200-day average. That sits between the model's 30% and 55% breadth thresholds, so breadth alone decides nothing here. On the day 12 rose and 14 fell; the median move was −0.30%.

1 ticker has a 14-day RSI at or below 30 (GOOG), and 1 at or above 70 (SPYV). An RSI extreme records how one-sided recent trading has been. It is not, by itself, evidence that the move is about to reverse.
